Memory can be used to pre-buff Energy Shield to make the Enchant Sorceress tankier.

quotes: Your Mercenary needs maximum Resistances, Life Leech, a high damage Weapon, and high Defense and/or Damage Reduction to stay alive reliably. Cannot Be Frozen is also a great stat for maintaining Mercenary DPS and leech. Ethereal gear is preferred since it doesn't lose durability. Gear Options at each Gear Level perform equally well in different situations; choose based on Farming Spots and/or personal preference. Slot Early-Game Mid-Game End-Game Weapon Insight Insight Infinity Breath of the Dying Body Armor Smoke Lionheart Skin of the Flayed One Goldskin Rockfleece Gemmed Dusk Shroud Venom Ward Treachery Duress Shaftstop The Gladiator's Bane Duriel's Shell Guardian Angel Fortitude Chains of Honor Treachery Helmet Bulwark Undead Crown The Face of Horror Gemmed Mask Temper Ground Cure Tal Rasha's Horadric Crest Guillaume's Face Vampire Gaze Crown of Thieves Stealskull Kira's Guardian Rockstopper Cure Cure The Mercenary is hard to keep alive until you have the minimum gear recommended in this guide. Remember you can drag Healing Potions onto the portrait, or shift + 1/2/3/4 to directly feed them a Healing Potion from your Belt. The Mercenary also gains bonus Resistances from Thawing Potions and Antidote Potions. If your Mercenary dies in battle, you can revive them from any of the Mercenary NPCs in each Act. This does come with an increasing cost, capping at 50,000 Gold. Keep that in mind and decide if the Mercenary is currently worth the cost.
